description: This file defines synchronization primitives such as CriticalSection, BinairySemaphore, CountingSemaphore, and Event within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and external method references related to thread synchronization and locking mechanisms.

classes.name: CriticalSection
classes.description: A class providing mutual exclusion lock functionality, supporting POSIX and Windows platforms.

classes.name: BinairySemaphore
classes.description: A class implementing a binary semaphore for thread synchronization, supporting platform-specific implementations.

classes.name: CountingSemaphore
classes.description: A class implementing a counting semaphore for managing access to a resource with a maximum count.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: A class representing an event object for thread signaling, supporting manual and automatic reset modes.

classes.name: SafeSyncType
classes.description: A template class providing RAII-style locking for synchronization objects.
